scripts.build: npm --workspace @neneen/contracts run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.format: prettier --write "backend/src/**/*.ts" "backend/prisma/**/*.ts" "frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "frontend/*.ts" "shared/contracts/**/*.ts" package.json .prettierrc.json backend/package.json backend/tsconfig.json frontend/package.json frontend/tsconfig.json frontend/tsconfig.app.json frontend/tsconfig.node.json shared/contracts/package.json shared/contracts/tsconfig.json README.md eslint.config.js
